about: Ho! Surf is a surf shop and hire centre on the village green in Westward Ho!, overlooking the sea. It hires surfboards, wetsuits, bodyboards and SUPs, and SurfSUP Academy runs surf and paddleboard lessons from the shop.
offers: SUP tours on the Torridge (SurfSUP Academy)
where: Ho! Surf shop, village green, Westward Ho!
goodToKnow: Hire only when conditions are safe, and not at high water
Changing facilities, and you can leave clothes at the shop
gaps: No Ho! Surf website was found, and the SurfSUP site does not mention hire. Hire details come from the Visit Westward Ho! listing, and the season was not stated.
